body:
## Summary

Since 2.0.0-rc.7, an element that spreads props which include `children` — `<a {...props} />` in a wrapper component — makes the SERVER consume one extra hydration id. The client numbers contiguously, so every element after the first such spread claims the wrong server node (or a detached one), and the client halts with `[REACTIVITY_HALTED] TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'nextSibling')`. rc.6 is clean with the same (rc.7) compiler, so it is a runtime change.

## Cause

In `@solidjs/web`'s server `ssrElement`, rc.7 hoisted `const value = props[prop]` above the `ChildProperties.has(prop)` early-`continue` (for the `<textarea value>` handling in `b64071c`). For `prop === "children"` the compiled getter now runs twice — into the discarded `value`, then again in the `ChildProperties` branch — and each run builds the child element, which calls `ssrHydrationKey()`. The discarded build's id is the skipped one. Server `_hk` sequence for three spread-built anchors with a child each, then a `<pre>`:

```
rc.6 server:  a=001 span=002 a=003 span=004 a=005 svg=006 pre=007
rc.7 server:  a=001 span=003 a=004 span=006 a=007 svg=009 pre=00a
client:       a=001 span=002 a=003 span=004 a=005 svg=006 pre=007   (both versions)
```

## Reproduction

<https://github.com/TylerRick/solid-spread-children-hydration-id-repro> — `pnpm install && node server.mjs & node check.mjs`. Pure `solid-js` + `@solidjs/web`, `renderToStream` + `hydrate`, no router. `?variant=` selects the shape; the table in its README shows `<a {...props} />` with `children` in the spread is the whole trigger (7 warnings, click handlers dead at rc.7; 0 at rc.6), and that `omit(props, 'children')` on the spread makes it clean again.

## Expected

The server evaluates `children` once per element, as rc.6 did, so server and client hydration ids agree. Reading `value` lazily (after the `ChildProperties` check, or only for the textarea case) would restore that.

**Versions**: solid-js / @solidjs/web / @solidjs/signals 2.0.0-rc.7, @solidjs/babel-plugin + compiler 2.0.0-rc.7, @solidjs/vite-plugin 3.0.0-next.40, vite 8.2.1, Node 24.

comments.body: > Confirmed and fixed in 3b4db215 — thank you for the precise diagnosis; your `_hk` tables and the pointer at the hoisted `value` read were exactly right, and the fix is the one you suggested: the read moves back below the `ChildProperties` early-out, with the textarea branch (#3286) reading its own value. > > The regression was slightly wider than the self-closing case: the hoist also made `ssrElement` read a spread's `children` once when JSX children were present, where it previously never read it — so a wrapper like `text` with an element `children` in the spread would have skipped an id too. Both paths are pinned now: getter-count specs assert `children` fires once when self-closing and zero times with JSX children, every other spread key fires exactly once, and your repro shape asserts the exact contiguous id sequence. > > This ships in rc.8 shortly. > > — *Claude via Cursor*

title: 2.0.0-rc.7 SSR: `ssrElement` reads `props.children` twice for a spread, skipping a hydration id — every later element hydrates onto the wrong node
